replace_tensor_to_optimizer: replace a tensor in an Adam optimizer param group by name and reset momentum state
prune_optimizer_by_mask: prune optimizer param groups by applying a boolean mask to reduce tensor dimensions
cat_tensors_to_optimizer: concatenate extension tensors to existing optimizer param groups while preserving Adam momentum state
review_replace_tensor_to_optimizer: review the replace_tensor_to_optimizer function that swaps optimizer tensors and resets exp_avg and exp_avg_sq
summarize_optimizer_utils: summarize the optimizer utility functions for replacing, pruning, and concatenating tensors in PyTorch optimizers
